kind.description: What it redirects: a provider, plan, add-on or bundle id, or a feature or perk rank key (video.quality=4k, perk:xbox-game-pass/fortnite-crew)

from.description: The old id: gone from the catalog, or a retired plan or provider

to.description: The id it points to now, which exists and is still sold. A perk can point to a feature rank key

on.patternErrorMessage: Use a real date written YYYY-MM-DD
on.description: The day the id changed, or the day a retired plan's subscribers move to the new one

title: Simply Sub redirects
description: data/redirects.yaml: old id → new id, for an id that had to change or a retired plan's subscribers moved (BLUEPRINT §4.3)
